sees: frame 1: A bald man with brown sideburns in a black tuxedo with bow tie stands in a pale living room (picture frame, lamp, sofa). He holds a small dark closed book or box in his raised right hand, looking slightly to the side.
frame 2: Same room and pose; the small dark object is still in his hand, held at about waist height, essentially unchanged.

frame 3: The background has changed to a city street with grey buildings and a lamp post. The man's arm is extended outward and the dark object is now an open book with pages and lines, floating in the air away from his hand.
actor: a bald man with brown sideburns in a black tuxedo and bow tie
before: in frame 1 the man holds the closed dark book in his hand in an indoor room
after: in frame 3 the book is open and hovering/held out in front of him, away from his body, in an outdoor city setting
change: the setting moves from a quiet room to a city street; the closed book is opened and held out or released into the air by the man's outstretched arm
consequence: unclear, but it suggests knowledge or an idea from a book being presented or shared with the wider world or the future
message: The narrator seems to be saying that insight or knowledge from a book is opened up and offered out into the wider world beyond the private room.
